propositions: Manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured must be replaced with a single bounded Agent operation preserving full request history and stored response

Wire-context projection via HistoryProcessor must conditionally include failed ModelResponse only when full request plus output reserve fits the model window, omitting response entirely if it does not fit

Truncation-triggered concision retry must be guarded to prompted output mode only, raising ModelRetry with fixed concision instruction before parsing, while native output mode remains terminal with existing guard_capability
One shared request budget combining base allowance and output-retry allowance must be computed once with no per-attempt reset, pinned behaviorally by the limit-matrix oracle
Authoritative-input overflow must raise ContextWindowExceededError with no shortening of system/user/tool content when input alone exceeds window capacity
Refusal and content-filter responses must remain terminal after one model call, never triggering output retry or fallback via ModelRetry in capability hook
